ctx.x: She was a music teacher, yes. She was a school teacher and music, she taught music. So what I did was to study with her, you know, and then I would dance, you know, and the opportunity came to join Alphonso. Mrs. Pittman said to me when she first heard me touch the piano, you know, she wanted to see how I knew and how I could play little things. She said, "Sammy, you have an exceptional knowledge of the instrument. You know, and a good feeling. I don't know if you'll ever become a great reading musician, but you…
feeling with other musicians who are trained." That was exactly what she said to me, and I thought that was a pretty good compliment.
